title_zh: 把下次跑步目标定为三十二分钟内

scenario.goal_zh: 根据以往成绩选定具体目标而不只关注名次

context_zh: 业余跑者和教练根据上次五公里成绩商量下次比赛目标。
author: author-phase04-b

sentences.speaker: Evan
sentences.text: I was the last runner in my group again. Perhaps I should give up running.

sentences.speaker: Salma
sentences.text: What was your time in the previous race?

sentences.speaker: Evan
sentences.text: Thirty-four minutes. Yesterday I finished in thirty-two minutes and ten seconds.

sentences.speaker: Salma
sentences.text: That is almost two minutes faster. Your position depends on who else enters, but your time shows your progress.

sentences.speaker: Evan
sentences.text: Then I want to get under thirty-two minutes next time, rather than aim for a place.

sentences.speaker: Salma
sentences.text: That is a clear goal. We can plan your sessions around it.
